newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU ENDS FLAT, MONEY MARKET SLIGHTLY UP.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU ENDS FLAT, MONEY MARKET SLIGHTLY UP.

text.p: 1310 GMT - The Romanian leu currency closed Wednesday clinging to morning levels of about 7,000/100 to the dollar on a dollar-heavy interbank market, traders said.
* Operators said volumes improved slightly but hard currency supply continued to exceed demand.
* Latest central bank data put interbank volume at $23.8 million on Tuesday, when overall trading was $55.3 million.

* Overnight money market prices climbed towards 95 percent from about 85 percent in early trading with banks keen to invest their leu funds in the fixed-interest T-bills to be offered at Thursday's public subscription.
* The leu's rates at the currency shops were slightly lower at 6,800/7,000 against around 6,700/6,950 in early trading.
